Welcome to the Wolfpack Weekly

The digital newsletter of Air Force ROTC Detachment 90 at Colorado State University.

Produced and managed by the Outreach Flight, this platform is built not just to keep our current wing connected, but to give family members, friends, alumni, and prospective cadets an inside look at what we do. Whether you are a parent following your cadet's journey, a high school student considering joining our ranks, or a current cadet staying up to date on the training tempo, this is your primary source for all things Det 90.

Our mission is to highlight the hard work, dedication, and camaraderie that make our detachment thrive. From recaps of Leadership Labs and physical training to cadet spotlights and upcoming event announcements, the Wolfpack Weekly celebrates the excellence of our cadets every single week.

Stay connected, stay informed, and go Wolfpack!

Have an idea for an issue?
